div.div: الحَقُّ أَبْلَجُ وَالبَاطِلُ لَجْلَجٌ (AZ, S) [Truth is apparent, manifest, or evident, or clear, and falsity is a cause of embarrassment, or hesitation, to the speaker]: i. e., the latter is agitated to and fro, without having utterance: (S:) or truth is lucid and direct, and falsity is confused and indirect. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
